verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal that ships `grep` (shown filtering text in a pipe) and an included Vim editor, so it offers basic in-terminal text filtering over files. The evidence never documents searching code content, regex patterns, or fuzzy matching. missing for 10: fuzzy matching (no fzf or equivalent documented), documented regular-expression code search, filters for code navigation (e.g. by file type or path), any hands-on corroboration of code search workflows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and navigate code content using fuzzy matching, filters, and regular expressions

citations.quote: `help -l | grep command` will tell you if your favorite command is already installed.
a-Shell comes with Vim included. You can edit your files and even run syntax checkers using e.g. vim-lsp or ALE.
The goal in this project is to provide a simple Unix-like terminal on iOS.
